HOW IT WORKS / A QUICK NOTE

A strong cut starts
with a strong moment.

ClipForge samples your clip for visual changes and audio energy, then picks distinct high-signal moments for a short first cut. It favors movement and peaks; it does not know what is trending or guarantee views.

The scan runs in your browser. Your video is not uploaded. You can adjust each cut, change the framing and opening line, then render a WebM file on this device.
